title: 第1185章 抱也抱了能不能亲一下第1184章 合作的基础就是欺负女人
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
温香软玉在怀。
他终于抱住了这个冰冷大美人。
林云顿时心情大好，整个人都被幸福满足包裹住了。
叶倾仙也是整个人都呆住了。
她似乎也没想到这个混蛋会这么大胆。
但是她本来可以挣脱的。
但是在被这个家伙抱住的时候，她竟然感觉到了某种温暖。
这种温暖安心的感受，竟然让她有些舍不得离开。
也就是这一瞬间的犹豫。
就让她再也没有了脱离的可能。
因为林老魔的大手已经揽住了她的腰肢。
隔着薄薄的的丝绸，也能完完全全的感受到她肌肤的温润和娇嫩。
林老魔感觉自己的手掌都仿佛陷入了进去。
他手臂微微用力。
抱的很紧，让两人之间都没有丝毫缝隙。
叶倾仙的胸口也是紧紧地挤压在他的胸膛上。
林云可以感受到那惊人的柔韧娇软。
眼角余光也能看见那将他灵魂都吸进去的深沟。
而脸庞靠得近，呼吸之间，更是她的发香和淡雅如兰的气息。
即使是一瞬间，林云就有沸腾。

他呼吸有些粗重了起来。
叶倾仙脸庞也是唰的一下就红了。
她瞪大了眼睛，似乎有些不知所措。
“你！”
“你滚远点！”她回过神来后娇声呵道。
林老魔自然不会放手。
反而又紧了紧手臂。
甚至还微微低头，在她的脖颈处嗅了嗅。
感受着她那让他着迷的味道。
“我确实没什么出息，但是可以拥有你，我就愿意付出一切。”
林老魔在她的耳畔柔声道。
叶倾仙感受着耳边的炙热气息。
只感觉整个人都有些酥软了起来，甚至有些站不住。
甚至也是变得软绵绵的。
而这就更加便宜了林老魔，他可以肆无忌惮的抱紧她。
让两人之间贴的更加紧密。
“你这话，留着去哄那些小姑娘吧。”叶倾仙微微咬着嘴唇。
强行让自己冷静下来。
她心中此刻扑通扑通的，甚至有些就此沉沦的念头。
这让她心中有些惶恐，也有些莫名其妙。

这家伙难不成对自己下药了么？
但是那也不对啊，自己可是仙皇境界。
要什么样的毒雾才能对自己见效呢。
而且自己也不可能一无所察。
content_en:
Warm and fragrant nephrite in my arms.
He finally hugged this cold beauty.
Lin Yun suddenly felt very good, and his whole body was wrapped in happiness and satisfaction.
Ye Qingxian was also stunned.
She didn't seem to expect that this bastard would be so bold.
But she could have broken free.
But when she was hugged by this guy, she actually felt some kind of warmth.
This feeling of warmth and security actually made her reluctant to leave.
It was this moment of hesitation.
It left her no longer able to escape.
Because Lin Laomo's big hands had already wrapped around her waist.
Through the thin silk, you can completely feel the warmth and tenderness of her skin.
Lin Laomo felt as if his palms were sinking into it.
He exerted slight force on his arms.
The hug was so tight that there was no gap between the two of them.
Ye Qingxian's chest was also squeezed tightly against his.
Lin Yun could feel the amazing flexibility and softness.
From the corner of his eye, he could see the deep groove that sucked his soul into it.
With his face so close, his breath was filled with the fragrance of her hair and her elegant orchid breath.
Even for a moment, Lin Yun was boiling.
He was breathing a little heavier.
Ye Qingxian's face suddenly turned red.
Her eyes widened and she seemed a little overwhelmed.
"You!"
"Get away!" she whispered after coming back to her senses.
Naturally, Old Demon Lin would not let go.
Instead, he tightened his arms.
He even lowered his head slightly and sniffed her neck.
Feeling her scent that fascinated him.
"I really have no future, but if I can have you, I'm willing to give everything."
Old Demon Lin whispered softly in her ear.
Ye Qingxian felt the hot breath in her ears.
I just felt that my whole body became a little soft, and I even felt a little unable to stand.
It even became soft.
And this was even more advantageous for Old Mo Lin, as he could hug her tightly without restraint.
Make the two people closer together.
"Save what you said to coax those little girls." Ye Qingxian bit her lip slightly.
Force yourself to calm down.
Her heart was pounding at the moment, and she even had some thoughts of sinking.
This made her feel a little scared and a little confused.
Could it be that this guy drugged himself?
But that's not right, he is in the realm of Immortal Emperor.
What kind of poisonous mist is needed to be effective on yourself?
And it is impossible for him to observe everything.
